title: Take a shot everytime I say “experience” (difficulty: impossible) #Ma...
transcript: For the first time ever, immersive Phantom is going to be giving us a look inside the experience. Up until now, they have been very secretive about what the actual experience looks like. We've gotten a handful of photos and some very vibey videos that capture the vibe of the experience but don't really show off what it looks like. But that is about to change as Playbill just announced that they're going to be doing an Instagram live to give us a tour of the Phantom's lair. The live will also feature a conversation with Diane Paulus, the director, as well as several of the actors playing Christine. Now, I don't know how much of the experience we're going to be able to see in this live. If you have seen the show, the Phantom's lair is like one specific floor of the five floor experience. I don't know if we are just going to see that floor of the experience or if we're going to see more of the experience and they're just calling it the Phantom's layer. But regardless, I am really glad to see them lifting the veil of mystery and showing us more of the experience, because obviously the experience is very expensive. And while I do think ticket prices are worth it, it is definitely not something everyone can afford, especially if you're not already in New York City. So being able to provide fandom fans around the world who are not able to get To masquerade at this moment, a chance to see inside the building, I think, is really exciting.
classificationReason: Discusses immersive Phantom experience but this show is not on the provided list
